TRAVEL CON

By: Nicky Troll | Delivery

Proposal


Show: Carte Blanche

One Liner (Tonight on Carte Blanche...):
We expose a so-called travel agent that sells travel dreams at a steal but delivers travel disasters instead.

Unique Selling Point:
LEKKER CROOK WITH A TRACK RECORD

OPPORTUNITY FOR GOOD CONFRONT

Summary:
This is not Kim Robbertse first scam – she’s pro!

In 2014 she made close to R4.4 MILLION in just four months leaving her clients stranded all over the world – ruining Christmas for hundreds of people. She was arrested and charged in 2015, the case is still on-going.

But, she’s BACK! She’s pocketed R2.2 million with her special deals – this time she took the Afrikaans music industry...

It would appear she’s got some explaining to do….

Further information:
The MO is simple – she advertises flight packages at ridiculously low rates – so cheap you’d think it’s a scam. But Kim is so good at selling her con – she makes it seem legtimate by actually booking flights for some people. They in turn become her best sales people – telling everyone they know about this amazing deal.

Like any con – it’s a limited offer and needs to booked within 24 hours.

20 return flights for just R5000! And just like that she takes hundreds of people in a couple of weeks.

Kim is from Polekwane – we know where’s she lives and get to her. I have eyes and ears in the town – so I am confident we’ll be able to get hold of her.

A LITTLE ABOUT KIM
She is a chronic crook - she lies about illness as well, ducks and dives when her clients realise they've been done in. She has basically admitted guilt and has offered to pay back the 2017 victims over 11 years.... she has offered to pay back R15000 a month - which would workout to R120 to each victim for 11 years. She is established in Polekwane and won't be running - her husband owns 10 spaza shops and we'll definitely be able to find her.


CASE STUDY 1:
De Waal Bothma – SA
He is Bobby van Jaarsveld’s drummer – he heard of the deal via a friend who had bought and flown on the package – so convinced of the authenticity of the deal he recommended Kim’s super special to everyone in the Afrikaans music industry.
AFFECTED PEOPLE: 124 people bought 225 deals from March to Aug 2017 – just over R2 million.
ACTION: CASES HAVE BEEN OPENED

CASE STUDY 2:
LAWYERS REPRESENTING A GROUP OF THE 2017 VICTIMS

CASE STUDY 3: WE GO BACK TO WHERE IT STARTED.
Marelize Verdoes – ENGLAND – SKYPE INTERVIEW
She is from Polekwane – and blames herself for the 2014 scandal – she referred all and sundry to Kim. Kim had people stranded in the UK heading home from Christmas and other in SA trying to go to the UK.
AFFECTED PEOPLE: In total Kim sold over 650 tickets and only delivered 219 adding up to R4.4 million from Aug to Dec 2014.
ACTION: Criminal cases were opened. Kim was charged, and the case is ongoing.

ASATA – ASSOCIATION OF SOUTHERN AFRICAN TRAVEL AGENTS
Kim was never a member of ASATA – but they will give us an industry perspective. In 2014 she used to present travelers with itineraries that have not been issued to give them the assurance that she was legit – but then people got stranded when they got the airport – no tickets there.

TRAVEL INDUSTRY INVESTIGATOR - CHRISTO SNYMAN
Christo looked into the case in 2014 and dealt with a number of victims - he can tell us about her MO, the impact and what happened with the investigation subsequently.

NPA INTERVIEW
I feel we should interview the NPA – the investigation has been dealt with by the SAPS and is in the process of being heard. Kim is out on bail – what does this mean and what action can they take?
Alternately we can interview the HAWKS - but I dont think they would add anything usefull as the ball is now in the NPA's court.

CONFRONT ☺




Extra Budget Items:
KIM IS IN POLEKWANE - SIX HOUR ROUND TRIP 620KM - WE DON'T NEED TO STAY OVER - BUT WOULD I WOULD NEED A THIRD DAY WITH THE PRESENTER.

MIGHT NEED CAR HIRE - IF 620KM IS TOO MUCH TO CLAIM FOR.

Case Study:
Marelize Verdoes 2014 VICTIM
De Waal Bothma VICTIM 2017
Loubser van der Walt Inc ATTORNEY REPRESENTING GROUP

Press Release:


Travel Cons
They sold travel dreams, but delivered nightmares instead: defrauding travellers out of hundreds of thousands and leaving clients stranded overseas. Then, when confronted by their patrons, they were nowhere to be found. Carte Blanche exposes a cunning couple masquerading as legitimate travel agents.


Script:


STRUCTURE

VO: The modern day travel bug has infected people globally, with a wanderlust only cured by travel. South Africans are not immune - making at least 5 million international trips every year.

LINK: We plot, we plan, we squeeze budgets to make those dream holidays a reality, but the devil is in the detail and sometimes even seasoned travellers could find themselves living a travel nightmare.

VO: Local travel agency Heyneke Tours, run by husband & wife team Izak and Henda, sold at least 14 clients overseas holidays that never materialised… the damage is close to R1 million .

DIANA: // She never paid the money over – she didn’t pay the airlines and she didn’t pay the hotel.

VO: Before this, Diana Coetzee and her family have done at least 35 trips with Heyneke Tours over the last 17 years, without any major hassles.

DIANA: I was travelling up and down – I think the people thought I was mad, because we got such good prices we couldn’t resist you know.

VO: But that lucky streak ended this past December – when Diana’s family lost close to R200 000 in fictitious travel bookings for trips to Bali, Thailand and the Maldives.

Diana paid Heyneke Tours just under R42 000 for a trip for two, to the Maldives. The incredible package included returns flights, 7 nights all-inclusive accommodation in a beach villa at a FIVE star resort.

OTTO: that doesn’t seem very likely.

VO: Otto de Vries is from ASATA – the Association for Southern African Travel Agencies. He says those prices are a long shot.

OTTO: Deals that are clearly too good to be true are being presented in front of the consumer.

LINK: Imagine getting to the airport, all packed, passport and travel documents in hand… ready to jet off - only to face one of two scenarios – one you discover you’re not actually booked on the flight or two, you’re on the flight but when you get to your destination you have no accommodation.

VO: After a lot of arguing, Heyneke Tours eventually provided Diana with the return flights – the accommodation was not provided despite it being part of the R42 000 package that Diana already paid for.

DIANA: She looks me in the eyes and says it has been paid – I said to her Henda, I’ve contacted the hotels – it’s not been paid.

VO: Diana had to cough up an additional R57 000 for hotel accommodation – that’s over and above - the R42 000 she paid to Heynekes tours. The hotel voucher they supplied her - was fake.

OTTO: This is a confirmation of the reservation issued by Heyneke – anyone could get on a computer and type this out.
DEVI: Is Heyneke Tours registered with ASATA?
OTTO: No, they are not – we are familiar with Hyneke Tours as they had applied for membership probably around 10 years ago now and they did not meet our criteria // it was specifically related to our financial requirements.

VO: Heyneke Tours was not a fly by night operation.

LINK: they have been in the travel industry for almost two decades – but judging by the complaints in the past year - it seems they’ve gone rogue… ROGUE LINK

VO: While Diana at least got part of the travel she paid for – others have not been so lucky.

o AN ISLAMIC TRAVEL GROUP – LOST AROUND R218 000 FOR A TRIP TO THE FAR EAST

o ANSA KLEYNHANS – paid R42 000 for a trip to Morocco

o HUSSEIN RASOOL - PAID JUST OVER R60000 for his dream trip also to the FAR EAST.

o MARIETTE MINNIE-BOTBIJL – paid over R72000 for a trip to Thailand for her 40th

o MARIUS MOSTERT – paid R90 000 for a white Christmas in Europe (Germany) that he didn’t get.

LINK: After having their travel dreams dashed…. these clients were left frustrated when they tried to report it to police – who repeatedly insisted that this was a civil matter.

CAROL: Once it becomes a pattern – it becomes fraud…

VO: Attorney Carol van Molendorff represents 8 clients who’ve been done in by the Heynekes.

CAROL: it is quite clear if I take this money and I tell you that I’ve paid your tickets and I promise you that I’ve paid your tickets and that I’ve booked it and I haven’t // It’s definitely fraud

VO: Could it be that the Heynekes were rolling the cash - taking in money for one trip and using it to pay for another client’s holiday?

Van Molendorff points out - this would not be ethical business practice.

DEVI: IF they had cashflow problems what should they have done?
CAROL: // if you look at their terms and conditions it states that you have to pay the airline tickets by a certain time, the accommodation must be paid. So every money that they receive a portion is specifically for someone – it’s not a general business.

VO: Kirsty & Rolf Gastrow are pursing it both criminally and civilly – they booked their April honeymoon with Heyneke Tours in November last year, at a R30 000 price tag for a week in paradise.

KIRSTY: He contacted them and they were very professional and he paid – he paid 100% for our honeymoon in Mauritius.

VO: But 5 weeks later there were still no confirmed travel documents – so Kirsty contacted Henda Heyneke.

KIRSTY: She said don’t worry – it’s been booked. // A couple of days later she sent confirmation – got on my phone and I phoned Mauritius – I asked has the booking been made – the lady said yes – but I didn’t ask her if it had been paid.

VO: So for the time being Kirsty’s mind was at ease – until they received a message from the friend that referred them to the Heynekes.

KIRSTY: My fiancé got a message // saying I really hope you didn’t book with Heyneke Tours she’s stealing money…

VO: The booking was indeed made but NOT paid for.

LINK: This is the house from where the Heynekes operated their travel agency from. They’ve apparently sold the property but only vacated late last year – since then they’ve been ducking and diving with no new offices.

CAROL: It seems as if even the police can’t get hold of them – the big issue is we don’t’ know where they are.
DEVI: They’ve disappeared
CAROL: They’ve disappeared.

VO: We made some calls and eventually got hold of Izak Heyneke.

UPSOUND – What I can suggest, what I want you to do is to contact my lawyer Louis Nel.
DEVI: Whether you give an interview or not the story still goes ahead.

VO: We spoke to Louis Nel, who didn’t appear up to speed on the case.

UPSOUND: I need to have a more detailed chat with my client // but I cant make a decision either way until I have had a chat to them.

VO: They promised to come back to us after they consulted with financial experts.

In December, some Heyneke Tours clients received this email from so-called consultants appointed to help them through their cash flow problems. They stated the following facts:

- They do not have any money - not to pay tour costs. Not to give refunds

And then it seemed to switch to bullying tactics…. Saying if the company goes into liquidation or business rescue the prospects of a refund is minimal.

The email was signed by Mr Black & Mr Kubeke – no contact details and no company name. It’s all a little suspicious says Van Molendorff.

CAROL: I don’t think that is at all a legit email // there was not letter head to make it formal or a signature to the email – that is really laughable.
DEVI: Do you think they wrote it themselves
CAROL: Yes.

VO: From the client experiences, we know that the Heynekes are quite good at creating hotel confirmations and flight itineraries that weren’t real– it seems it could be trend.

DEVI: The FAKE STUFF THE EVIDENCE
CAROL: that makes it even more fraudulent

LINK: We never heard back to the Heynekes, their lawyer or their so-called financial advisers. It appears they’ve been in hiding – avoiding old clients, potential new clients, attorneys and even the police…. But, we’ve established that they’re still on the West Rand… let’s go see if we can find them…..

VO: We located them in an upmarket area in Roodepoort… it’s a boomed off road, with big security and big dogs. Izak spoke to us, reluctant to come out from the fancy safe haven.

DEVI: But it looks like you’re hiding now…
IZAK: No I am not….
DEVI: Well, what is this – I am talking to an intercom system… you are hiding….
DEVI: How many people did you defraud?
IZAK: That’s not a good word to use….
DEVI: do you know what defraud means – you take people’s money and you don’t give them the service that they paid for… that’s what it means….
IZAK: um.. but unfortunately…. It is in the legal processes now and what we are busy with is to look at these things.
DEVI: I specialise in criminals… it comes across as criminal behaviour and you are hidding
IZAK: I’m not…
DEVI: What are you then?
IZAK: normal human…
DEVI: You are not a normal human being – normal people don’t take other people’s money. And that’s what you did…

VO: Seemingly unwilling to take any responsibility - Izak insisted that he can’t comment any further.

LINK: The worst thing is when you do something that’s wrong but you deny it…

VO: ASATA’s advice for travel consumers is simple.

OTTO: This is a professional industry – // you wouldn’t go to a doctor or an accountant that isn’t registered with professional body and we encourage people to do the same when you are booking travel services.

VO: But as Kirsty explained – the Heynekes were not your typical crooks.

KIRSTY: They will answer your questions, they answer their phone, they reassure you // you actually don’t think that this loving couple – because they are an elderly, polite couple would steal from you.


PROMOS

PROMO 1
VO: We expose a couple behind a so-called travel agency that sells travel dreams but appears to pocket the money delivering travel disasters instead.

PROMO 2
OTTO: Deals that are clearly too good to be true are being presented in front of the consumer.

VO: We investigate a local travel agency that promised big deals and delivered very little if anything – leaving travellers stranded and out of pocket.


PROMO 3
VO: When it comes to international travel – the devil is in the detail.

KIRSTY: I asked has the booking been made // but I didn’t ask her if it had been paid.

VO: We investigate a travel agency that took clients for a ride.

CAROL: I don’t think that is at all a legit email // there was not letter head to make it formal or a signature to the email – that is really laughable. DEVI: Do you think they wrote it themselves CAROL: Yes. VO: From the client experiences, we know that the Heynekes are quite good at creating hotel confirmations and flight itineraries that weren’t real– it seems it could be trend. DEVI: The FAKE STUFF THE EVIDENCE CAROL: that makes it even more fraudulent LINK: We never heard back to the Heynekes, their lawyer or their so-called financial advisers. It appears they’ve been in hiding – avoiding old clients, potential new clients, attorneys and even the police…. But, we’ve established that they’re still on the West Rand… let’s go see if we can find them….. VO: We located them in an upmarket area in Roodepoort… it’s a boomed off road, with big security and big dogs. Izak spoke to us, reluctant to come out from the fancy safe haven. DEVI: But it looks like you’re hiding now… IZAK: No I am not…. DEVI: Well, what is this – I am talking to an intercom system… you are hiding…. DEVI: How many people did you defraud? IZAK: That’s not a good word to use…. DEVI: do you know what defraud means – you take people’s money and you don’t give them the service that they paid for… that’s what it means…. IZAK: um.. but unfortunately…. It is in the legal processes now and what we are busy with is to look at these things. DEVI: I specialise in criminals… it comes across as criminal behaviour and you are hidding IZAK: I’m not… DEVI: What are you then? IZAK: normal human… DEVI: You are not a normal human being – normal people don’t take other people’s money. And that’s what you did… VO: Seemingly unwilling to take any responsibility - Izak insisted that he can’t comment any further. LINK: The worst thing is when you do something that’s wrong but you deny it… VO: ASATA’s advice for travel consumers is simple. OTTO: This is a professional industry – // you wouldn’t go to a doctor or an accountant that isn’t registered with professional body and we encourage people to do the same when you are booking travel services. VO: But as Kirsty explained – the Heynekes were not your typical crooks. KIRSTY: They will answer your questions, they answer their phone, they reassure you // you actually don’t think that this loving couple – because they are an elderly, polite couple would steal from you. PROMOS PROMO 1 VO: We expose a couple behind a so-called travel agency that sells travel dreams but appears to pocket the money delivering travel disasters instead. PROMO 2 OTTO: Deals that are clearly too good to be true are being presented in front of the consumer. VO: We investigate a local travel agency that promised big deals and delivered very little if anything – leaving travellers stranded and out of pocket. PROMO 3 VO: When it comes to international travel – the devil is in the detail. KIRSTY: I asked has the booking been made // but I didn’t ask her if it had been paid. VO: We investigate a travel agency that took clients for a ride.

metadata.Summary: This is not Kim Robbertse first scam – she’s pro! In 2014 she made close to R4.4 MILLION in just four months leaving her clients stranded all over the world – ruining Christmas for hundreds of people. She was arrested and charged in 2015, the case is still on-going. But, she’s BACK! She’s pocketed R2.2 million with her special deals – this time she took the Afrikaans music industry... It would appear she’s got some explaining to do….
metadata.Further information: The MO is simple – she advertises flight packages at ridiculously low rates – so cheap you’d think it’s a scam. But Kim is so good at selling her con – she makes it seem legtimate by actually booking flights for some people. They in turn become her best sales people – telling everyone they know about this amazing deal. Like any con – it’s a limited offer and needs to booked within 24 hours. 20 return flights for just R5000! And just like that she takes hundreds of people in a couple of weeks. Kim is from Polekwane – we know where’s she lives and get to her. I have eyes and ears in the town – so I am confident we’ll be able to get hold of her. A LITTLE ABOUT KIM She is a chronic crook - she lies about illness as well, ducks and dives when her clients realise they've been done in. She has basically admitted guilt and has offered to pay back the 2017 victims over 11 years.... she has offered to pay back R15000 a month - which would workout to R120 to each victim for 11 years. She is established in Polekwane and won't be running - her husband owns 10 spaza shops and we'll definitely be able to find her. CASE STUDY 1: De Waal Bothma – SA He is Bobby van Jaarsveld’s drummer – he heard of the deal via a friend who had bought and flown on the package – so convinced of the authenticity of the deal he recommended Kim’s super special to everyone in the Afrikaans music industry. AFFECTED PEOPLE: 124 people bought 225 deals from March to Aug 2017 – just over R2 million. ACTION: CASES HAVE BEEN OPENED CASE STUDY 2: LAWYERS REPRESENTING A GROUP OF THE 2017 VICTIMS CASE STUDY 3: WE GO BACK TO WHERE IT STARTED. Marelize Verdoes – ENGLAND – SKYPE INTERVIEW She is from Polekwane – and blames herself for the 2014 scandal – she referred all and sundry to Kim. Kim had people stranded in the UK heading home from Christmas and other in SA trying to go to the UK. AFFECTED PEOPLE: In total Kim sold over 650 tickets and only delivered 219 adding up to R4.4 million from Aug to Dec 2014. ACTION: Criminal cases were opened. Kim was charged, and the case is ongoing. ASATA – ASSOCIATION OF SOUTHERN AFRICAN TRAVEL AGENTS Kim was never a member of ASATA – but they will give us an industry perspective. In 2014 she used to present travelers with itineraries that have not been issued to give them the assurance that she was legit – but then people got stranded when they got the airport – no tickets there. TRAVEL INDUSTRY INVESTIGATOR - CHRISTO SNYMAN Christo looked into the case in 2014 and dealt with a number of victims - he can tell us about her MO, the impact and what happened with the investigation subsequently. NPA INTERVIEW I feel we should interview the NPA – the investigation has been dealt with by the SAPS and is in the process of being heard. Kim is out on bail – what does this mean and what action can they take? Alternately we can interview the HAWKS - but I dont think they would add anything usefull as the ball is now in the NPA's court. CONFRONT ☺
